## Workflow package

Create Hearts of Iron IV-style leader portraits with ComfyUI, the distilled FLUX.2 Klein 9B model, and the project's HOI4 style LoRA.

The package contains four workflows:

- **Source portrait** — prepare a photograph, optionally restore it with the complete Adonis Base → Post path, and create three portrait candidates.
- **Text to image** — create a fictional portrait from a written description.
- **Batch** — rescan a folder on every queue and process its photos one by one with automatic, non-overwriting PNG and DDS saves.
- **Portrait processing** — crop, upscale, and optionally restore a source image without applying the HOI4 style LoRA.

Full, FP8, and GGUF installs all use distilled FLUX.2 Klein 9B weights and keep the HOI4 style LoRA plus Adonis Base, Refine, and Post. Every workflow saves a full-resolution PNG, a 156×210 PNG, and a HOI4-ready DDS. Image-based workflows preserve the source filename stem in every output; three-candidate source runs add `_1`, `_2`, and `_3`.

Model downloads stay fast by transferring independent repositories in parallel while files from the same repository run sequentially to avoid competing for one Xet token. Temporary Hugging Face rate limits retry automatically, and rerunning the installer verifies completed files and resumes incomplete Hub downloads instead of starting the whole installation over.

## Downloads

- **Model-free ZIP** — workflows, guides, installers, custom nodes, and bundled assets.
- **Windows x64 installer** — detects VRAM, recommends a distilled model variant, and installs the selected models and workflows into ComfyUI.
- **RunPod runtime archive** — installs the same workflows and dependencies on an existing ComfyUI pod.

## Before installation

Accept the [FLUX.2 Klein 9B agreement](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9B) and create a [read-only Hugging Face token](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens/new?tokenType=read) when installing the gated full or FP8 model. GGUF does not require a token.

## RunPod installation

Run this in the RunPod web terminal:

```bash
(
set -euo pipefail
export HF_TOKEN="hf_..."
COMFY_ROOT=/workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI
RUNTIME_DIR=/workspace/hoi4-portrait-runpod
test -f "$COMFY_ROOT/main.py" || { echo "ComfyUI not found at $COMFY_ROOT; set COMFY_ROOT to the folder containing main.py."; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/klimPaskov/comfyui-hoi4-portraits/releases/latest/download/HOI4-Portrait-RunPod.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$RUNTIME_DIR"
"$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/install_runpod.sh" "$COMFY_ROOT"
)
```

Restart ComfyUI, then open a workflow from **Workflows → hoi4_portraits**. The RunPod installer defaults to the full distilled model; use `--variant fp8` or `--variant gguf --gguf-quants Q5_K_M` when appropriate.
